== Spelling: Whaley, not Whatley (20 October 2026) ==
I checked the 2007 Worlds deck sheets: Day 2 pages 23 and 24 and Team page 22 all read ''Thomas E. Whaley''. The 2015 and 2016 Texas Mini Worlds pages also list ''Thomas Whaley''. None of the sheets or results pages gives "Whatley", so the page title stays [[Thomas Whaley]]. I moved the three 2007 deck pages to "Thomas E. Whaley" titles (redirects kept), fixed their credits and the [[2007 World Championship]] links, and added redirects from [[Thomas Whaley|Thomas Whatley]] and [[Thomas Whaley|Thomas E. Whaley]]. [[Thomas Whaley|Thomas E. Whatley]] still redirects here. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 02:09, 21 October 2026 (UTC)
